verdict.rationale: GitBook documents version control, Git sync and change-request review, but only for documentation content. Nothing in the evidence shows that its automations (GitBook Agent tasks, auto translations, integrations) can themselves be versioned, reviewed or rolled back. Content versioning is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for automation versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
